question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Superb
solution:
The correct answer is '**Inferior**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's go through the meanings of the words and then select the appropriate antonym for "**superb**": **inferior**.

 
 
• **Infallible** (अपराध न करने वाला) - incapable of making mistakes or being wrong; perfect or unerring.
 
• **Incorrigible** (जिसे सुधारा नहीं जा सकता) - not able to be corrected, improved, or reformed; persistently bad in behavior or attitude.
 
• **Inferior** (निम्न) - lower in rank, status, or quality; not as good as something else.
 
• **Splendid** (शानदार) - magnificent; excellent; very impressive or beautiful.
 
 
 
• Among these options, the most appropriate antonym for "**superb**" is: **Inferior**.
 
• Explanation:
 
 
• "**Superb**" means excellent, outstanding, or of very high quality.
 
• "**Inferior**" is the opposite, indicating something that is of lower quality or standard compared to another. 
 
 
 
• ***Sentence using the correct option:**__ The quality of the second product was inferior to the first one, which was truly superb in terms of its design and performance.*
